title: Hotaru no Yomeiri

thread.title: Firefly Wedding • Hotaru no Yomeiri - Episode 4 discussion

opinions.point: Viewers praised the episode’s escalating romantic tension and the leads’ unusual, compelling dynamic.
Several reactions appreciated the deeper characterization and psychological nuance given to the male lead.
Some commenters found the increasingly obsessive relationship entertaining, while others remained uncomfortable with its unhealthy implications.
A few reactions criticized recurring threats and plot complications as frustrating, particularly where they seemed to repeat earlier conflicts.

notes: The thread title, show identity, and episode number match exactly. Reddit itself was not directly retrievable, so score/comment count and sentiment were cross-checked through indexed mirrors and pages summarizing the Reddit thread; spoiler details were excluded.
